test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Neha has ______ and won't come to work for a few days.
solution: The correct answer is** "flu."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Flu"** is short for **"influenza",** which is a highly contagious respiratory illness. (एक अत्यधिक संक्रामक श्वसन रोग) • **Example**: *The **flu**__ is caused by a virus.* • Grammatically, **"flu"** is the correct option to use with the auxiliary verb** "has"** in this sentence. • Other possible options ("floo", "flue", "flew") do not fit the context or grammatical structure of the sentence. • The correct answer is Option 2. **Correct sentence**: *Neha has __**flu**__ and won't come to work for a few days.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Floo"** is not a word in English. • **"Flue"** refers to a channel or pipe that carries smoke or gas out of a building. (धुआँ, गैस या गरम हवा बाहर निकालने के लिए नली जो विशेषतः चिमनी या धुआँकश में लगी होती है) • **"Flew"** is the past tense of the verb **"fly"**, and does not make sense in this sentence. ((पक्षी, कीट, विमान आदि का) हवा में गति करना, उड़ना) 188:T5c6, The correct answer is **"Careful in trivial matters but wasteful in large."**
